titulo: Remove duplicates from a sorted array
enunciado: Compact the sorted array {1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 7, 7, 9} in place so that the distinct values are at the beginning. Show the new size and the valid part.
objetivos: Use a read index and a write index
Tell array capacity from logical size
pistas: Since it is sorted, repeated values are adjacent.
Copy a[i] to the write position only if it differs from the last written value.
The logical size is the final write position.
